parameters.help_en: The template name. The name can be up to 30 characters in length. You can view the names of templates that failed the review on the China Mainland Messages > Template Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template) tab in the console. You can also call the [QuerySmsTemplateList](~~QuerySmsTemplateList~~) operation to query the names of SMS templates that failed the review

parameters.help_en:
The template content. The content can be up to 500 characters in length.

The template content and variable content must comply with the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/463161.html. Otherwise, the template will fail the review. You can also view common template examples on the Apply for Template (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template/add) page. Using example templates can improve the review efficiency and success rate. For variable specifications, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2806243.html
parameters.help_zh:
模板内容，长度不超过500个字符。

模板内容和变量内容必须符合https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/463161.html，否则模板会审核失败。您也可以在申请模板 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template/add)页面，查看常用模板示例。使用示例模板可提高审核效率和成功率。变量规范请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2806243.html
parameters.name: template_content

parameters.help_en: Describe your business scenario for using SMS or provide an online link to the business scenario, and provide a complete SMS example with variable content filled in. Complete information helps improve the template review pass rate. If you do not fill in the information as required or leave it empty, your template review may be affected
parameters.help_zh: 请描述您使用短信的业务场景或提供业务场景的线上链接，并提供短信完整示例（填入变量内容），信息完整有助于提高模板审核通过率。如未按规范进行填写或不填写，可能会影响您模板审核的通过
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The SMS type. Valid values:

0: verification code.
1: SMS notification.
2: promotional SMS.
3: international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan message.

Only enterprise-authenticated users can apply for promotional SMS and international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan messages. For details about the differences between individual and enterprise user privileges, see Usage notes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sms/user-guide/usage-notes)
parameters.help_zh:
短信类型。取值：

0：验证码。
1：短信通知。
2：推广短信。
3：国际/港澳台消息。

仅支持企业认证用户申请推广短信和国际/港澳台消息。个人用户与企业用户权益区别详情请参见使用须知 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/sms/user-guide/usage-notes?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.67447f576NJnE8)
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en:
The business scenario.
If the scenarios of the SMS signature associated with the template is "Online APP", `ApplySceneContent` must be an App link starting with `http://` or `https://`.
If the scenarios of the SMS signature associated with the template is "Registered trademark name" or "Enterprise or public institution name", `ApplySceneContent` is required
parameters.help_zh:
业务场景。
模板关联的短信签名使用场景如果为“已上线APP”，`ApplySceneContent`必须为以`http://`开头或`https://`开头的App链接。
模板关联的短信签名使用场景如果为“已注册商标名”、“企事业单位名称”，`ApplySceneContent`必填
parameters.name: apply_scene_content

parameters.help_en:
The international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan template type. When the TemplateType parameter is set to 3, this parameter is required for international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan templates. Valid values:
0: SMS notification.
1: promotional SMS.
2: verification code
parameters.help_zh:
国际/港澳台模板类型。当TemplateType参数为3时，国际/港澳台模板需要设置此参数，取值：
0：短信通知。
1：推广短信。
2：验证码

parameters.example: [{"trafficDrivingType":"DOMAIN","trafficDrivingContent":"aliyun.com","companyName":"阿里云计算有限公司","organizationCode":"91330****73959654P","icpNo":"浙B2-20****01-4","icpPicOssKey":"db7784d8-cb0c-498f-****-295f1ad6d665_mf29l7nf.png","companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason":"这是一段说明文字"},{"trafficDrivingType":"1_PHONE","trafficDrivingContent":"1**86","variableName":"my1Phone","companyName":"阿里云计算有限公司","organizationCode":"91330****73959654P","companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason":"这是一段说明文字"}]
parameters.help_en:
<warning>
To manage SMS content security, SMS content that contains traffic-driving information such as phone numbers and links may be blocked by carriers, resulting in delivery failures. Avoid including such information in SMS templates to reduce the risk of delivery failures.></warning>

The JSON string of the traffic-driving information list.
<notice>JSON format. Convert to a string before passing in.></notice>

Field description:

{
    "trafficDrivingType":"Traffic-driving type",
    "trafficDrivingContent":"Traffic-driving content",
    "variableName":"Variable name",
    "companyName":"Enterprise or public institution name",
    "organizationCode":"Unified social credit code",
    "icpNo":"ICP filing/license number",
    "icpPicOssKey":"ICP filing screenshot OssKey",
    "companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason":"Reason why the enterprise name differs from the signature qualification"
}

Notes:

If it is not a variable, do not pass in variableName.

If the enterprise or public institution name differs from the enterprise name in the signature qualification, pass in companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason.

If trafficDrivingType=DOMAIN, pass in all parameters.

If trafficDrivingType is set to other values, pass in trafficDrivingType, trafficDrivingContent, variableName (as needed), companyName, organizationCode, and companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason (as needed).

Enumeration values for trafficDrivingType:
<warning>Due to regulatory requirements, mobile phone numbers are not supported.></warning>

DOMAIN: domain name link.
FIXED_PHONE: landline phone.
400_PHONE: phone number starting with 400.
800_PHONE: phone number starting with 800.
95_PHONE: phone number starting with 95.
96_PHONE: phone number starting with 96.
1_PHONE: phone number starting with 1, 3 to 8 digits.
OTHER_PHONE: other phone numbers
parameters.help_zh:
<warning>
为管控短信内容安全，短信内容中包含“号码、链接”等引流信息，存在被运营商拦截导致发送失败的风险。建议尽可能在短信模板中避免包含相关信息，以降低短信发送失败风险。></warning>

引流信息列表JSON字符串。
<notice>JSON格式，传入前请转为字符串。></notice>

字段说明：

{
    "trafficDrivingType":"引流类型",
    "trafficDrivingContent":"引流内容",
    "variableName":"变量名称",
    "companyName":企事业单位名称,
    "organizationCode":统一社会信用代码,
    "icpNo":ICP备案/许可证号,
    "icpPicOssKey":ICP备案截图OssKey,
    "companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason":企事业单位名称与签名资质不同原因
}

注意事项：

如果非变量则variableName不传。

企事业单位名称与签名关联资质的企事业单位名称不同，则传入companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason。

如果trfficDrivingType=DOMAIN，则传入所有参数。

如果trafficDrivingType为其他，则传入trafficDrivingType、trafficDrivingContent、variableName（按需）、companyName、organizationCode、companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason（按需）

trafficDrivingType引流类型枚举值：
<warning>因监管要求，不支持手机号码。></warning>

DOMAIN：域名类型链接。
FIXED_PHONE：固定电话。
400_PHONE：400开头电话。
800_PHONE：800开头电话。
95_PHONE：95开头电话。
96_PHONE：96开头电话。
1_PHONE：1开头，3~8位电话。
OTHER_PHONE：其他号码
